## In-place upgrades
One record per state transition, written by the `AzureInPlaceUpgrade` module through the Logs Ingestion API. The **State** is what the `UpgradeState` tag says; the **Result** is what the job decided.

content.query:
InPlaceUpgrade_CL
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by VMName
| summarize VMs = count() by State
| order by State asc
content.title: VMs by current state

content.query:
InPlaceUpgrade_CL
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by VMName
| project TimeGenerated, VMName, ResourceGroupName, Target, State, Result, SourceBuild, TargetBuild, Engine, ImageIndex, DurationMinutes, TaskResult, Snapshot
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Latest record per VM

content.query:
InPlaceUpgrade_CL
| where Result == 'Failed' or Result == 'NotEligible'
| project TimeGenerated, VMName, Result, Mode, TaskResult, Reason
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Failures and refused preflights

content.query:
InPlaceUpgrade_CL
| where Result == 'Completed'
| project TimeGenerated, VMName, SourceBuild, TargetBuild, DurationMinutes
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Completed upgrades and how long Setup took

content.query:
InPlaceUpgrade_CL
| summarize Records = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m), Result
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Activity over time
